'''M'Kae''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[communications officer]] in the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was stationed on board the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Avenger]]'' and served in the crew pit on the [[starship]]'s [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]].

In [[3 ABY]], the ''Avenger'' was a part of [[Death Squadron]] and was charged with destroying the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' as it attempted to escape from the rebel defeat at the [[Battle of Hoth]]. While pursuing the ''Falcon'', the [[YT-1300 light freighter|freighter]] disappeared from the ''Avenger''{{'s}} scanners, and M'Kae informed [[Captain]] [[Lorth Needa]], [[Commanding officer|commander]] of the ''Avenger'', that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] demanded a report on their progress.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Shields up!|Lorth Needa gives orders to M'Kae and the rest of the ''Avenger's'' bridge crew|audio=Needa-ShieldsUp.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:MKae_crew_pit.png|thumb|left|250px|M'Kae worked in the crew pit of the ''Avenger''.]]
The [[human]]<ref name="ESB" /> M'Kae<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2019 Topps Star Wars Black & White: The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=Mark Capri as Officer M'Kae|link=https://www.tradingcarddb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/196703/cid/12614769/2019-Topps-Star-Wars-Black-&-White:-The-Empire-Strikes-Back---Autographs-NNO-Mark-Capri}}</ref> served as a [[communications officer]]<ref name="ESB Junior Novel" /> in the [[Imperial Navy]] and was stationed in the crew pit on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]<ref name="ESB" /> of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Avenger]]'',<ref name="S&V4">{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|4|History of the Ship}}</ref> which was a part of [[Death Squadron]].<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} to [[3 ABY]].</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="ESB" /> the ''Avenger'' participated in the [[Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="NeedaDB">{{Databank|captain-needa|Captain Needa}}</ref> and was among the [[Starship|ships]] that pursued the fleeing ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', a rebel [[YT-1300 light freighter]], in the aftermath of the battle.<ref name="ESB" />

The ''Falcon'' evaded capture by hiding out in the [[Hoth asteroid field]], eventually encountering the ''Avenger'' when it attempted to escape. After the ''Falcon''{{'s}} [[hyperdrive]] failed to function, the ship's [[captain]], [[Han Solo]], turned the vessel around and started flying directly toward the ''Avenger''. The Star Destroyer's [[Commanding officer|commander]], Captain [[Lorth Needa]], gave orders for the ship's [[Deflector shield|shields]] to be raised, after which M'Kae flipped a switch on<ref name="ESB" /> his<ref name="ESB Junior Novel" /> console. The ''Falcon'' then flew in close past the bridge's [[viewport]]s, causing M'Kae to look up from what he was doing while Needa and others closer to the viewport ducked for cover.<ref name="ESB" />

[[File:MKaeAndFriends-ESBBR.png|thumb|right|250px|M'Kae relays Vader's communications to Captain Needa.]]
Needa immediately ordered that the ''Falcon'' be tracked, but was informed that it had disappeared from the ''Avenger''{{'s}} scanners. M'Kae then informed the captain that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] wanted an update on their progress in capturing the ''Falcon''. Needa chose to report the failure to Vader in person, and was consequently [[Death|executed]] by the [[Sith]] for his failure. The ''Falcon'', meanwhile, had landed on the ''Avenger''{{'s}} [[Conning tower|command tower]] in order to evade its scanners, and was able to escape undetected by the [[Galactic Empire|Imperials]], although not unnoticed by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
M'Kae had fair skin and [[Color|dark blond]] [[hair]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
M'Kae [[Clothing|wore]] a light gray [[Imperial officer's uniform|Imperial uniform]] with a black [[belt]] and a darker gray [[Imperial kepi|cap]] bearing an [[officer's disk]] and a communications [[headset]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
M'Kae was created for the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']],<ref name="ESB" /> in which he was portrayed by [[Mark Capri]].<ref name="Topps" /> Capri shot his scenes on the Star Destroyer bridge on Stage 5 at [[Elstree Studios]] at some point between [[April 24]] and [[May 2]], [[1979]].<ref name="365Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref> The character was not identified in the film,<ref name="ESB" /> but referred to as a "communications officer" in the script.<ref name="ESB Notebook">''[[The Empire Strikes Back Notebook]]''</ref> Capri is also visible on the bridge of the ''[[Executor]]'' toward the end of the film due to footage from the bridge of the ''Avenger'' being reused, but this article assumes that this is a different character.<ref name="ESB" /> The character was first named in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] on a card in the ''[[2019 Topps Star Wars Black & White: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' set of trading cards released by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]]<ref name="Topps" />

In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, M'Kae appeared prior to the release of ''The Empire Strikes Back'' in the [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|novelization]] of the film written by [[Donald F. Glut]].<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> The character's name originated on a card in the ''[[Dagobah Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] in [[1997]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Warrant Officer M'Kae}}</ref>
